about.title: About
about.subtitle: Frontend developer, Almaty — Vue 3, Nuxt 3, TypeScript. Currently at Bigplay.gg.
bio: I'm Dauren, a frontend developer based in Almaty. I write Vue 3 and Nuxt 3 with TypeScript and have kept legacy Vue 2 / Vuex alive too — I take work from turning a mockup into markup all the way to store architecture and API integration.

Right now I'm building the BIGPLAY.GG esports platform: moved requests to SSR and cut TTFB by 35%, tracked down a memory leak with fuite.js and shrank the payload from 3000 KB to 200 KB, built a UI kit from scratch and reworked 40+ pages and 20 widgets.

Before that, two years at Elefanto: the Studyhub EdTech marketplace, the ucc-109 emergency call automation and the mega.kz mall portal. I introduced Feature-Sliced Design there, covered stores and composables with Jest/Vitest, and grew into a middle role running reviews and mentoring.
I like interfaces that don't just work but feel right: careful transitions, honest scrolling, no needless spinners — and all of it inside a performance budget.
